import sys
from collections import OrderedDict

lines = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
c = int(lines[0].strip())
d = OrderedDict()
out = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    p = line.split()
    if not p:
        continue
    if p[0] == 'put':
        k, v = int(p[1]), int(p[2])
        d[k] = v
        d.move_to_end(k)
        if len(d) > c:
            ek, _ = d.popitem(last=False)
            out.append("evict %d" % ek)
    elif p[0] == 'get':
        k = int(p[1])
        if k in d:
            d.move_to_end(k)
            out.append(str(d[k]))
        else:
            out.append("-1")
    elif p[0] == 'keys':
        out.append(' '.join(str(k) for k in reversed(d)) if d else "<empty>")
print('\n'.join(out))
